analysis:
## Technical analysis (Tuesday June 30 — 11:01 UTC partial candle)

**June 30 UTC partial candle (Crypto.com MCP):** O$60,255.20 / H$60,281.89 / L$59,183.60 / C$59,339.47. Volume 986 BTC ($58.5M) in ~11 hours.

**Day 9 gate: $62,000 is $2,660.53 away (+4.48%) with ~13 hours to midnight UTC.** Virtually locked.

**Day high set at the open.** $60,281.89 vs $60,255.20 open — classic distribution: open near prior close, sellers immediately active, price distributes lower through the session.

**Volume deceleration is the standout development.** 986 BTC in 11 hours (pace: ~2,000 BTC full day) vs June 29's 3,433 BTC. Distribution is exhausting. This is the most constructive structural signal of the nine-session window.

**Support holding.** Day low $59,183.60 is above June 29's $58,884.95 — the $59,000-$59,200 zone is absorbing the selling. Two consecutive intraday tests of the $58,900-$59,200 zone without a sustained break confirms accumulation at support.

**US session catalyst window (13:30-19:00 UTC).** Quarter-end window dressing could push BTC +2-3% toward $61,000. Still $1,000 short of gate at that level.

**Post-Q2 expiry.** $10.6B quarterly options expiry clears at June 30 midnight UTC — removes supply pinning mechanics for July.

so_what.line: Day 9 of the distribution window with volume deceleration as the key positive signal — 986 BTC in 11 hours vs 3,433 BTC on June 29 shows sellers exhausting — but the gate is $2,660 away and the NFP binary on July 2 into the holiday gap prevents re-entry regardless of gate status.
so_what.bull: Volume deceleration across nine sessions, $59,000 support holding after two intraday tests, and post-$10.6B quarterly options expiry clearing tonight removes the structural supply mechanics that pinned BTC to $57,500-$61,000 through Q2 close — the setup for a recovery attempt is building.
so_what.bear: Nine consecutive closes below $62,000 on declining but still-elevated distribution volume, with the day high set at the open ($60,281 vs $60,255 open), confirms that the sellers own the $60,000-$62,000 range and buyers haven't shown the conviction to reclaim $61,000 in nine attempts.
